title: Client-initiated key re-exchange not answered with KEXINIT
quote: Key re-exchange is started by sending an SSH_MSG_KEXINIT packet when not already doing a key exchange (as described in Section 7.1). When this message is received, a party MUST respond with its own SSH_MSG_KEXINIT message, except when the received SSH_MSG_KEXINIT already was a reply.
rationale: After a completed initial KEX and any ordinary traffic (no KEX inputs, no DISCONNECT, no teardown, no server KEXINIT), a client KEXINIT whose output lacks KEXINIT is a violation; this includes closing the connection or answering with UNIMPLEMENTED.
